item.description:

Do what thou wilt shall be the whole of the law

I was always superstitious about posting anything before the run is complete but after seeing the show for free, it's just not good enough to spend real money. Last show or not.

Not to mention what I was always superstitious about actually happened, but I still escaped and pulled it off and am not going back to the Hollywood Bowl ever again. Unless someone wants to give me a ticket that might get burned. That's all I am going to say about that.

Recorded from near the top but dead center. I figured moving down would not be prudent this time.

Retirement is imminent anyway, was thinking 2 years tops to coincide with my own 40th anniversary assuming I am still alive, housed, civilization has yet to totally collapse, etc. I am going to need a job to keep going by then. I just don't want one.

I am starting to suspect I was listening to the backing band rehearse and someone else was going ballistic.
